Shut down of STG # 04 due to “No Demand” by KE from January 01 to 04, 2025.

On 3 February 2025, steam leakage started from the insulating gasket flange of the 18” MPS Export Line at the FPCL – FFC-PQ battery limit, causing a drop in MPS header pressure. The leakage led to STG-3 tripping on low MPS header pressure, and MPS export was subsequently cut off, interrupting the startup of Ammonia plant at FFC-PQ.
